sentences.en: I wish I had not bought such a useless thing.
sentences.zh: 我真希望没有买这么个没用的东西。

sentences.en: The retired often feel that they are useless and unproductive.
sentences.zh: 退休的人常常觉得自己无用且不productive。

sentences.en: It is useless to try to persuade him to agree.
sentences.zh: 试图说服他同意是徒劳的。

senses.zh: 无用的，无价值的；差劲的，无能的；无效的，徒劳的；（身体一部分或心智因有病或受到损害而）丧失功能的
